meta.title: Free GPS Tools & Format Converters | Dawarich
meta.description: Privacy-first online tools for visualizing, analyzing, merging, and converting GPS and location history files. Everything runs in your browser — no data leaves your device.

intro: Privacy-first utilities for working with GPS and location history files. Everything runs in your browser — your data never leaves your device.
toolsIntro: Visualize, analyze, merge, and split your location history — no uploads, no accounts.
convertersIntro: Convert GPS and map data between formats. All processing happens locally in your browser.
ctaBody: These tools handle one-off tasks. Dawarich is the complete location history platform — interactive maps, trips, statistics, photo integrations, and EU-hosted data privacy.

tools.title: Google Timeline Visualizer
tools.description: View your exported Google Timeline data on an interactive map. Supports all export formats.

tools.title: Google Timeline Converter
tools.description: Convert Google Timeline exports between formats. Handles Records.json and Semantic Location History.

tools.title: Timeline Statistics Analyzer
tools.description: Get insights into your location history: total distance, countries, cities, visits, and more.

tools.title: Timeline Mileage Calculator
tools.description: Calculate total driving and travel distance from your Google Timeline data.

tools.title: Timeline Data Merger
tools.description: Combine multiple Google Timeline exports into a single dataset without duplicates.

tools.title: Google Timeline Splitter
tools.description: Split a large Google Timeline file into smaller chunks by year or month.

tools.title: GPS File Splitter
tools.description: Break large GPX, KML, and GeoJSON files into smaller pieces for easier handling.

tools.title: Timeline Format Detector
tools.description: Identify which Google Timeline export format your file uses so you know how to process it.

tools.title: GPS Heatmap Generator
tools.description: Turn location history into a heatmap showing where you spend the most time.

tools.title: Map Poster Maker
tools.description: Compose a map poster from any GPS file — 17 themes, PNG/PDF export, optional prints.

tools.title: GPX Track Merger
tools.description: Combine multiple GPX files into a single track. Useful for multi-day trips or imports.

tools.title: Photo Geodata Extraction
tools.description: Extract GPS coordinates and location metadata from your photos (EXIF data).
